target_customer: Online shoppers buying furniture and home decor who want the cheapest store for the exact same item
problem: Many furniture items are white labeled and sold by several retailers at different prices under different names and SKUs. Spoken matches identical items and compares prices.
business_model: Affiliate commissions from retailers, with a stated brand-agnostic stance
product_category: Furniture and home decor price comparison

founders.name: Dane Hurtubise
founders.background_notes: Two-time technical YC founder per the YC page.

founders.name: Geoff Abraham
education: BA, University of Texas at Austin (Plan II)
previous_startups: Cabrio Taxi (built and sold, San Francisco)
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the YC page and Retail Brew.

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching identical products across retailers with different names and SKUs requires scraping and product matching at scale, plus a browser extension.

defensibility.rationale: The product match database takes effort to build, but price comparison is easy to imitate and retailers can block scraping.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; Retail Brew in 2022 quoted the founder saying no other company occupies this approach.

market_need_then: The founder started after finding a coffee table sold at roughly half price by another retailer; Business of Home called the site viral in July 2022.

branding.brand_signature: Exposing white labeled furniture and the exact same item for less
branding.community_and_virality: Business of Home (July 2022) called it a viral site; later coverage by Lifehacker, Furniture Today and Marketplace is listed on the YC page

brand_strength.rationale: Press called the site viral and the company drew national coverage, but the name is a generic English word with several unrelated companies sharing it.

outcome_analysis: Spoken launched in November 2021 as a furniture price comparison site, drew viral press in 2022 and expanded to a Spoken Explore product with over a million products. YC lists it inactive, yet coverage in 2024 describes it as live, so the status and any shutdown cause are not public. Funding appears small, and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Website spoken.io returned HTTP 402 to the fetch tool, so the live status could not be checked. Round rests on one database (Standout, 500K pre-seed with named investors; Extruct dates a pre-seed to 4 Nov 2021 and lists YC and Goodwater). Retail Brew names YC only and says funding undisclosed. YC status Inactive conflicts with 2024 press; exit unknown. No competitor named in coverage; dated 2021 sources not found.
